Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released UPSC CAPF AC Result 2026 on 25th August 2026. The result is out for the written exam conducted on 19th July 2026. The UPSC CAPF result PDF is out containing roll numbers of candidates shortlisted for the Physical Standards Test/Physical Efficiency Test (PST/PET). Candidates can check the UPSC CAPF Assistant Commandant Result 2026 by downloading UPSC CAPF merit list PDF and checking for their roll number. The candidature remains provisional until eligibility and original documents are verified at later stages. Check here the latest updates on UPSC CAPF AC exam.

UPSC CAPF Result 2026 Overview

Important details of UPSC CAPF Result 2026 are given below. This overview helps the candidates to check the examination stage, result date, written examination date and next stage of the recruitment process in a quick manner.

UPSC CAPF Result 2026 PDF Download

The UPSC CAPF Result 2026 is now released on the official UPSC website. Candidates who appeared in the examination can find their roll number or name in the merit list PDF from the direct link given below. List of candidates recommended for appointment as Assistant Commandants in BSF, CRPF, CISF, ITBP and SSB is given in the PDF. Click on the link below to access and download the UPSC CAPF Final Result 2026 PDF.

Download UPSC CAPF Result 2026 PDF

How To Check the UPSC CAPF Result 2026?

Now you can check UPSC CAPF Result 2026 on the official website of UPSC and download the PDF of result easily. Please follow the below mentioned steps to check your merit list and to confirm your eligibility status.

  1. Go to the official website of www.upsc.gov.in.
  2. Then on the homepage, you can click on the “What’s New” or “Results” section.
  3. After that find and click on the “UPSC CAPF (Assistant Commandants) Result 2026” link.
  4. The result PDF will open on your screen.
  5. Press Ctrl + F and enter your Roll Number or Name to search the PDF.
  6. If your details appear in the merit list, you have been recommended for appointment.
  7. Download and save the result PDF for future reference.

UPSC CAPF Result 2026 Direct Link

UPSC CAPF Result 2026 PDF is out in the form of a press note with roll numbers of candidates who qualified for PST/PET. Candidates should download UPSC CAPF result PDF from official UPSC website and check their roll number carefully.

The result can be accessed through the Examinations → Written Results section of the UPSC website. Candidates should look for the notice titled “Central Armed Police Forces (Assistant Commandants) Examination, 2026 – Result of Written Part.”

The roll-number list is provided in the press note. Candidates can use Ctrl+F function on a computer or the search option in their PDF viewer to find their roll number quickly.

How to Contact UPSC for CAPF Final Result Query?

In case of any query regarding UPSC CAPF Final Result 2026 or recruitment process, candidates can approach UPSC Facilitation Counter or contact on phone – in person or over phone – from 10.00 am to 5.00 pm on working days. The Commission will also upload the marks obtained by the candidates on its official website within 15 days from the date of declaration of final result.

UPSC CAPF PST/PET 2026 Dates

Selected candidates in UPSC CAPF Result 2026 will be required to appear in Physical Standards Test (PST) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET). The nodal authority nominated by the Ministry of Home Affairs for conducting these physical tests is Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB).

SSB will release the date, time and venue of PST/PET to the shortlisted candidates. The intimation and e-Admit Card would be available on the SSB recruitment website. Candidates are advised to check their registered email address, including the spam folder regularly for any further communication. Candidates are advised to wait for the official SSB communication before appearing for the physical tests.

UPSC CAPF Result 2026 FAQs

Ques: Is the UPSC CAPF Result 2026 the final result?

Ans: No! The UPSC CAPF Result 2026 released on 25 August 2026 is the result of the written part of the examination. It contains the roll numbers of candidates who have qualified for PST/PET. Final selection will be done after further stages and verification.

Ques: When was the UPSC CAPF Assistant Commandant written exam conducted?

Ans: The UPSC CAPF Assistant Commandant written examination 2026 was conducted on 19 July 2026. UPSC subsequently released the written result on 25 August 2026, listing the roll numbers of candidates shortlisted for PST/PET.

Ques: What is the UPSC CAPF Result 2026 release date?

Ans: The UPSC CAPF Result 2026 release date is 25 August 2026. UPSC issued a press note containing the roll numbers of candidates who qualified in the written examination for the PST/PET stage.

Ques: Does the UPSC CAPF Result PDF contain candidates’ names?

Ans: No! UPSC CAPF written result PDF contains only roll numbers of candidates who qualified for PST/PET. Candidates’ names and ranks are not printed in the result PDF.

Ques: What is the time period allowed for updating DAF/CAF after the announcement of CAPF result?

Ans: Those who get selected for PST/PET have to undertake the process of DAF/CAF updation within 15 days of the announcement of written exam result.

Ques: Who will conduct the UPSC CAPF PST/PET 2026?

Ans: The Ministry of Home Affairs has entrusted the task of conducting PST/PET for those candidates who qualify in the written examination to Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB).
